title: add transactional downgrade guard, version pinning, and backup/restore verification for upgrade/rollback tooling
author: Ananya Rao
body: Motivation: Improve safety and observability for Private installer upgrades and rollbacks by making schema migrations transactional, adding a downgrade guard that prevents irreversible migrations during downgrade paths, pinning component/chart/module versions for deterministic rollbacks, and adding a post-backup verification step to the backup/restore flow. This PR bundles changes across the installer CLI, Helm charts, and Terraform modules so that upgrades have a clear, testable rollback path and operators get explicit failures if attempting unsupported downgrades. Changes include: transactional DB migration wrapper (BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK and idempotency checks), a downgrade-guard check that compares current and target schema versions and aborts when encountering non-reversible migrations, Helm values and chart version pinning for control-plane components, Terraform module version constraints and provider pinning, and a backup verification command that validates backup consistency and restores in a dry-run mode. Checklist: - [x] Add transactional migration wrapper and idempotency markers - [x] Implement downgrade guard in cli/upgrade and helm hooks - [x] Pin chart/module versions and add tooling to surface diffs on upgrade - [x] Add backup verify and dry-run restore commands - [x] Integration tests for upgrade -> downgrade abort and backup/restore dry-run - [x] Documentation updates (upgrade/rollback runbook + changelog) Testing: unit tests for migration wrapper and downgrade-guard logic; integration test harness added to perf-canary that runs a full upgrade -> backup -> attempted downgrade and asserts guard triggers; local manual verification against a test Postgres instance and K8s kind cluster. Rollout: merged to main; we will cut a patch release for the private-installer package and coordinate with Platform to publish pinned Helm charts to the chart registry. Backward compatibility: guard is opt-out via --allow-unsafe-downgrade for migration/debugging workflows but defaults to safe behavior. See release_notes for operator-facing notes and runbook steps.
commits_summary: db: add transactional migration wrapper and idempotency checks
cli: add downgrade guard and preflight version checks
helm: pin control-plane chart versions and add chart-diff post-upgrade check
tf: pin module/provider versions and add upgrade validation step
backup: add verify and dry-run restore commands
docs: upgrade and rollback runbook + changelog entries
review_comments: Michael Chen: Strongly prefer making the migration wrapper idempotent at SQL level — added suggestions to mark migrations with a GUID and a completed timestamp. See inline on transactional.go:23
Ananya Rao: Addressed by adding idempotency.sql and checking migration markers before applying. Also added tests to cover repeated apply attempts.
Priya Kapoor: Helm pinning looks good, but we should surface a diff summary before applying to prevent surprises. Suggest adding chart-diff to preflight.
Ananya Rao: Added chart-diff hook and updated charts/control-plane/values.yaml with pinned versions and documented how to interpret diffs.
Ethan Walker: CI flaked on first run due to kind cluster timeouts. Re-ran the integration job and verified test stability under increased timeouts.
Michael Chen: Approved after the fixes and test rerun — left approval on the PR.
Priya Kapoor: Approved. Suggest follow-up to expose --allow-unsafe-downgrade telemetry if we ever enable opt-out in automation.
release_notes:
- Add transactional schema migration wrapper to make upgrades/rollbacks safer.
- Prevent unsupported downgrades with a downgrade guard that aborts non-reversible migrations by default.
- Pin Helm chart and Terraform module versions to provide repeatable rollbacks.
- Add backup verify and dry-run restore commands to validate backups before upgrade.
Operators: read docs/runbooks/upgrade_rollback.md before upgrading clusters.
